summary_1line: Provoked by Shurpanakha’s taunts, Khara orders fourteen thousand demons to arm themselves and march from Janasthana to kill Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shurpanakha, disfigured and furious, beats her breast before Khara while pleading for Rama’s death in the demon court.
Khara mounts a विशाल golden chariot adorned with banners, bells, and emerald-studded wheels as his demon army gathers around him.
Fourteen thousand armed demons surge out of Janasthana with axes, spears, and banners, roaring as they march toward Rama.
